adversarial_tests: funding after T cannot affect context at T (PIT future mutation)
future rows mutation leaves context at T unchanged (temp copy)
past eligible row mutation changes context
out-of-order source rows normalize deterministically (sorted by funding_time_ms)
availability timestamp is respected (availability == settlement, not next_funding)
funding_pit_invariant: funding_time_ms == availability_time_ms == settlement_time_ms; data_time <= decision_time; future funding never visible at T

funding_timestamp_semantics.availability: settlement instant (rate knowable at settlement; no next_funding lookahead)
funding_timestamp_semantics.interval_taken_from: per-row funding_interval_hours from provider (8 standard, 2/4 during SOL 2022-11 schedule)
funding_timestamp_semantics.next_funding: derived as funding_time + funding_interval_hours*3600s; not an observation

oi_pit_invariant: oi_time <= decision_time for every observation used; no day-level future validity query (V2 causal reader)
price_pit_invariant: open_time <= decision_time; 1h kline interval semantics; no forward-filled closeTime leakage
verified_by: verify_arc01_data_authority pit_rules (reproduces OI V2 style adversarial tests)
